name: Weekly digest of new competitor Google ads in Slack

parameters.content:
## Weekly digest of new competitor Google ads in Slack

### How it works
Every Monday this workflow checks Google's Ads Transparency Center for your competitors and posts one Slack message with the ads that started since last week: counts by format (text, image, video), the landing pages they point to, and links to the five newest ads per competitor.

It uses the [Google Ads Transparency Scraper](https://apify.com/ninoventures/google-ads-transparency-monitor) actor on Apify with "only new ads" turned on, so the actor remembers what it has already seen. The first run has no history yet and reports everything it finds as new; from the second run on you only get changes.

### Setup
1. Create an Apify account and copy your API token (Settings > API & Integrations).
2. In **Fetch new ads**, create a Header Auth credential: name `Authorization`, value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`.
3. Connect Slack in **Post digest to Slack** and invite the bot to the channel.
4. In **Settings**, list competitor domains or brand names, set the region (two-letter code or `anywhere`) and the Slack channel ID.

### Cost
The actor charges $1.20 per 1,000 ads plus $1 per 1,000 for ad copy and landing pages. A typical weekly run for 5 competitors costs a few cents.

### Customization
Change the schedule, raise `maxAdsPerCompetitor`, or replace Slack with email or Google Sheets.

## Configure
Competitors, region and Slack channel.

## Get new ads
Runs the actor and waits up to 5 minutes for the results. Empty when nothing is new.

## Summarize and send
One message per run. Skipped when there are no new ads.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ queries: $json.competitors.split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean), region: $json.region, maxAdsPerQuery: $json.maxAdsPerCompetitor, includeAdDetails: true, onlyNewAds: true, monitorName: $json.monitorName }) }}
